A little guide to Little Eyes.

Your patients arrive automatically, check in, wait, see the doctor, pay and leave. There’s no rush and nobody leaves because of a long wait.

  1. Let your practice grow. Trial-frame exams take 50 seconds and earn 40 coins. Manual phoropter exams take 30 seconds and earn 50 coins. Every paid visit earns 10 XP.
  2. Upgrade your kit. XP milestones unlock equipment purchases. Every model shows its time and earnings multipliers. Owned kits stay yours, and switching is free.
  3. Make it yours. Customize pauses the clinic. Select a furnishing, tap a floor tile, then Confirm. Tap placed furniture to move or return it to inventory.
  4. Try a new finish. Wall and floor finishes are free. Choose a swatch and confirm.
  5. Inspect objects. Tap the visible part of a furnishing or machine to open its status and move controls. The Practice panel also lists all objects for keyboard access.
  6. Look around. Drag to pan, use +/− to zoom, or ⌂ to fit. Pinch to zoom on touch screens.

Keyboard: focus the clinic, use arrows to move a placement cursor, R to rotate, Shift+R to rotate back, Enter to confirm and Escape to cancel. Camera buttons work with keyboard too.

Your layout and earnings save in this browser. Reloading starts a fresh patient queue. There are no offline earnings; switching away pauses the clinic.
